acceptance_criteria: Every enforcement mechanism has an invalid fixture that fails

requirements.title: Project-local by default; no machine-global installer

acceptance_criteria: No installer scripts ship in sps2/
No machine-global path or global git config is referenced
GLOBAL install scope without user authorization is rejected
